The owner has not picked yet, so these are proposals; swap any line. Common theory, own 'why' wording. Needs owner review and engine check (tools/validate-content).

ideas.title: Why a bishop on c4
ideas.text: The bishop aims at f7, the weakest square in Black's camp, and gets out of the way so you can castle.

ideas.title: Why c3 and d3
ideas.text: c3 prepares d4 to take the centre later, and d3 keeps e4 safe. Calm moves, strong centre.

ideas.text: Answering e4 with e5 claims your share of the centre and gives your bishop and knight good squares.

ideas.text: Pawns on d5 and e6 hold the centre. Your bad-looking c8 bishop gets freed later, so be patient.
